meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将频道连接到代理组并管理隔离级别
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个频道与代理组的映射关系
copy.tagline_en: Wire channels to agent groups and manage isolation levels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage mappings between channels and agent groups

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会按你的要求把聊天渠道(如 Slack、Telegram)接到 AI 助手分组,设置对话隔离级别(共用对话/同助手分开对话/独立助手),新增渠道或渠道组,并展示当前接线情况。
howto.when: 当你说要接入或新增聊天渠道、调整渠道与助手分组的对应关系、查看当前接线时触发;也适用于添加渠道后或初始化设置阶段。

say.text: 把 Slack 工作区接到助手组 A,对话要共用。
say.note: 它会询问平台 ID 和隔离方式后执行接线。

say.text: 新增一个 Telegram 群,接到现有助手组 B,独立对话。
say.note: 它会引导配对并创建接线。

say.text: 把当前所有渠道的接线情况列出来。
say.note: 它会查询数据库并展示摘要。

howto.what_en: Claude can wire messaging channels to AI assistant groups, set isolation levels (shared session / same agent separate sessions / separate agent), add channels or channel groups, and show current wiring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect or add a messaging channel, adjust channel-to-agent-group mappings, or review current wiring; also after adding a channel or during setup.

say_en.text: Wire the Slack workspace to assistant group A with a shared conversation.
say_en.note: It asks for the platform ID and isolation choice, then wires it.

say_en.text: Add a Telegram group, connected to existing assistant group B, separate sessions.
say_en.note: It guides pairing and creates the wiring.

say_en.text: List the current channel wiring for everything.
say_en.note: It queries the database and shows a summary.
